tools.name: set_bucket_public_read_policy
tools.description: Grants anonymous public read access to objects under a given prefix in a bucket by updating its bucket policy. Replaces any existing policy statement with the same ID and saves the updated policy.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Key prefix to make publicly readable

tools.name: list_bucket_object_sizes
tools.description: Lists objects under a prefix in a bucket and returns their keys, sizes, and the total size in bytes.

params.name: max_keys
params.description: Maximum number of objects to return

tools.name: share_prefix_with_account
tools.description: Gives another AWS account read access to a key prefix in a bucket by adding a statement to the bucket policy, and tags the bucket with the account ID for tracking the share.

tools.name: run_glacier_restore_job
tools.description: Starts a batch restore job that retrieves archived objects listed in a manifest file from cold storage for a number of days.

params.name: account_id
params.description: AWS account ID that owns the bucket

params.name: manifest_arn
params.description: ARN of the manifest object listing the keys

params.name: role_arn
params.description: IAM role ARN the job runs as

params.name: expiration_days
params.description: Days the restored copies stay available
